sentences.l2: 在不同的国家，人们对时间的看法很不一样。
sentences.l1: In different countries, people's views of time are very different.

sentences.l2: 这种差别叫做“时间观念”。
sentences.l1: This difference is called "the concept of time".

sentences.l2: 在一些国家，比如德国或日本，守时性非常重要。
sentences.l1: In some countries, such as Germany or Japan, punctuality is very important.

sentences.l2: 人们觉得开会或约会迟到是不礼貌的。
sentences.l1: People think that being late to a meeting or an appointment is impolite.

sentences.l2: 他们喜欢把日程安排写得清清楚楚，几点做什么都计划好。
sentences.l1: They like to write out schedules very clearly, with what to do at what time all planned.

sentences.l2: 如果事情没按时开始，有些人会感到不开心。
sentences.l1: If things do not start on time, some people feel unhappy.

sentences.l2: 但在另一些国家，比如西班牙或巴西，人们对时间的看法更轻松。
sentences.l1: But in some other countries, such as Spain or Brazil, people's view of time is more relaxed.

sentences.l2: 朋友聚会可能说“晚上七点”，但真正开始可能是八点甚至更晚。
sentences.l1: A gathering of friends may be said to be at "seven in the evening", but it may really start at eight or even later.

sentences.l2: 大家不觉得这有问题，因为他们更看重人与人的交流，而不是严格遵守时间。
sentences.l1: Everyone does not think this is a problem, because they value communication between people more, rather than strictly keeping to time.

sentences.l2: 这种文化差异在全球化时代变得特别重要。
sentences.l1: This cultural difference becomes especially important in the age of globalization.

sentences.l2: 现在很多人要和不同国家的人一起工作。
sentences.l1: Now many people have to work with people from different countries.

sentences.l2: 比如，一个中国公司和一个墨西哥公司合作项目，双方对会议时间的理解可能不一样。
sentences.l1: For example, when a Chinese company and a Mexican company cooperate on a project, the two sides' understanding of meeting times may be different.

sentences.l2: 中国人可能习惯准时开始，而墨西哥人可能认为稍微迟到没关系。
sentences.l1: Chinese people may be used to starting on time, while Mexicans may think being slightly late does not matter.

sentences.l2: 如果双方不了解对方的时间观念，就容易产生误会。
sentences.l1: If the two sides do not understand each other's concept of time, misunderstandings easily arise.

sentences.l2: 所以，在国际交往中，了解别人的文化很重要。
sentences.l1: So, in international interaction, understanding other people's culture is very important.

sentences.l2: 不要马上判断别人“懒”或“不专业”，也许只是他们的生活方式不同。
sentences.l1: Do not immediately judge others as "lazy" or "unprofessional"; perhaps their ways of life are just different.

sentences.l2: 提前沟通日程安排，互相理解对方的习惯，才能更好地合作。
sentences.l1: Communicating the schedule in advance and understanding each other's habits are what make better cooperation possible.

sentences.l2: 守时性虽然重要，但理解和尊重文化差异同样重要。
sentences.l1: Although punctuality is important, understanding and respecting cultural differences are equally important.

sentences.l2: 这样，全球化的世界才会更和谐。
sentences.l1: Only in this way will the globalized world be more harmonious.
